description: This PHP class defines an admin controller for generating and listing product rating reports in an OpenCart project. It includes methods for initializing tasks that generate rating reports across products and for computing product ratings, integrating with models for products, reviews, and tasks.

classes.name: Rating
classes.description: Controller class for managing product rating report tasks and listing ratings in the admin panel of OpenCart.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Generates a list of rating report tasks based on the total number of products, dividing the work into chunks of 10 products each, and scheduling tasks accordingly.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Calculates and updates ratings for a list of products based on passed arguments; returns a success message with the range of processed products.
